name: ship
description: Assemble spec-grounded PR, propose afk/hitl routing. Run after /wrapup.

steps.name: Compose Intent block
steps.instruction: Resolve adapter from ## Deployment in CLAUDE.md. Write ## Intent from spec + ADR delta + resolved concern decisions. Never derive from diff. Mark 'spec-derived'.
checklist: Adapter resolved, Intent written from spec (not diff)

steps.name: Assess autonomy and preconditions
steps.instruction: Preconditions: Intent present, slice-to-criterion tracing verified, tests green, no blocking concerns. Compose afk gate: (1a) all slices tagged afk, (1b) wrapup blocking = none, (2) no load-bearing glob hit. All hold = afk, any fail = hitl.

steps.name: Route and open PR
steps.instruction: Route per engagement table. Print session digest + link. Open or hold per engagement tier. Surface reviewed-state as non-blocking note.
checklist: PR opened or held, digest printed

engagement.override: needs network and adapter; not Tier-1-offline

tone: Mechanical and honest. Ship proposes, target disposes.
